name: startbar
description: A taskbar for macOS. A bar along the bottom of the screen with a Start button, one button per open window, pinned apps and a clock.
author: Prather Bytecraft

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p src/renderer/bar && tsc -p src/renderer/calendar && tsc -p src/renderer/group && tsc -p src/renderer/menu && tsc -p src/renderer/popover && tsc -p src/renderer/preview && tsc -p src/renderer/settings && tsc -p src/renderer/settings/tsconfig.preview.json && tsc -p src/renderer/tip && tsc -p test/cypress
scripts.prepack: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: node dist/scripts/fix-electron.js && node dist/scripts/build-helper.js && node dist/scripts/build-app.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/unit/*.test.ts
scripts.test:helper: npm run build && node dist/scripts/build-helper.js && node --import tsx --test test/helper/*.test.ts
scripts.test:pages: npm run build && cypress run --config-file test/cypress/cypress.config.ts
